title: Mustafa Suleyman says Microsoft is "not able to build models in the very largest scale yet" but its "computation ramp is coming to enable us to do" it in 2026 (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Mustafa Suleyman says Microsoft is “not able to build models in the very largest scale yet” but its “computation ramp is coming to enable us to do” it in 2026 — Tech giant's AI chief says it will have the resources to build frontier systems later this year
contentText:
Financial Times :

Mustafa Suleyman says Microsoft is “not able to build models in the very largest scale yet” but its “computation ramp is coming to enable us to do” it in 2026   —  Tech giant's AI chief says it will have the resources to build frontier systems later this year
